Working Relationship  
Ines and I share a daily rhythm of collaboration, blending her technical precision with a knack for translating complex systems into actionable insights. As a Staff Platform Engineer, she’s the quiet force behind HealthCloud’s infrastructure, balancing hands-on execution with strategic foresight. Her work ethic is unshakable—whether debugging late-night issues or refining workflows, she approaches every task with deliberate focus.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Ines’s days are marked by a mix of operational oversight and proactive innovation. She’s regularly deploying AWS services to scale cloud resources, ensuring seamless integration with GCP for data processing pipelines. Her Terraform scripts automate environment setups, reducing deployment friction by 30% across teams. Cloud cost optimization is her specialty, where she’s slashed unnecessary spend by 15% through rigorous resource tagging and auto-scaling tweaks. Kubernetes is her go-to for managing microservices, with her recent refactor cutting deployment times by half.  

Standout Moments  
One standout was her leadership during a critical AWS migration, where she designed a hybrid architecture that improved system reliability without downtime. Another was her initiative to standardize IaC practices, which cut onboarding time for new engineers by 40%. Her ability to distill technical debt into clear roadmaps has kept our infrastructure agile amid rapid growth.  

Recommendation  
Ines’s blend of technical mastery and collaborative spirit makes her a rare asset. She’s equally comfortable troubleshooting edge cases or mentoring peers, always prioritizing clarity and reliability. Her work on AWS cost optimization and Kubernetes scalability has directly boosted HealthCloud’s operational efficiency. I’d wholeheartedly recommend her for any role demanding both depth and adaptability.
